With a clear roadmap ahead, we’re excited to continue expanding and leading the market with innovative products.

We have an amazing culture, strong financials, and best-in-class company metrics. It’s an exciting time to be part of an extraordinary startup that is already successful, yet still early enough to offer its team significant growth, equity, and the opportunity to make a real impact.

This position is for an existing vacancy.

We're looking for a Senior Revenue Operations Specialist to drive operational excellence, efficiency, and scalability across Roofr's Revenue organization. As a key member of the RevOps team, you'll play a hands-on role optimizing GTM processes, improving our technology ecosystem, strengthening data integrity, and building AI-ready systems that enable our Revenue teams to perform at their best.

You'll work closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Enablement to identify operational challenges, develop solutions, automate manual processes, and ensure our systems and workflows support a seamless customer and revenue lifecycle.

This is a highly collaborative, execution-oriented role for someone who enjoys solving complex operational problems, working deeply in systems and data, and turning business needs into scalable and AI-forward technology solutions.

What You'll Do:

Optimize Revenue Processes & Systems

  • Identify operational challenges across the Revenue org and develop scalable solutions that improve efficiency, productivity, and the GTM experience.
  • Design, implement, and continuously optimize Revenue processes, workflows, and systems across the customer lifecycle.
  • Apply a structured, project-management-oriented approach to understand problems, evaluate solutions, manage implementation, and measure outcomes.
  • Partner with Revenue leaders and ICs to understand their needs, gather feedback, test solutions, and ensure initiatives meaningfully improve team performance.
  • Look for opportunities to simplify processes, eliminate unnecessary manual work, and design human-in-the-loop AI workflows to improve efficiency for Revenue teams.

Drive Process Automation & AI Enablement

  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive and manual processes using existing technology, integrations, and automation platforms.
  • Build and maintain workflows, automations, routing, notifications, and other system-based solutions that improve team productivity.
  • Leverage connectors such as Fivetran, Zapier, or similar platforms to connect systems and improve data flow.
  • Continuously evaluate opportunities to use AI and emerging technologies to improve Revenue productivity and operational scale.

Own & Optimize the Revenue Technology Stack

  • Serve as a subject matter expert and administrator for HubSpot Marketing Hub and Sales Hub.
  • Own the creation, maintenance, and optimization of pipelines, workflows, custom views, templates, playbooks, lists, and other HubSpot functionality supporting Revenue initiatives.
  • Manage and optimize key Revenue technologies including Aircall, Sakari, Gong, Stripe, Hippo Video, and Guru.
  • Ensure systems are configured effectively, adopted appropriately, and integrated into Revenue workflows.
  • Stay current on product capabilities and emerging features, identify opportunities to improve our technology stack, and maintain relationships with key technology vendors.

Strengthen Data & Revenue Insights

  • Maintain strong data integrity practices across the tools, processes, and automations you own.
  • Ensure GTM data is clean, consistently structured, and AI-ready.
  • Use data to identify trends, diagnose operational issues, and measure the impact of Revenue initiatives.
  • Support analysis related to lead scoring, customer health, pipeline performance, conversion, productivity, and other Revenue performance indicators.
  • Translate data and operational insights into actionable recommendations for Revenue teams.

Partner Across Revenue

  • Work closely with leaders and ICs across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Enablement to inform your roadmap and prioritize initiatives.
  • Partner with the Revenue Enablement Specialist to ensure new tools, processes, and AI-assisted workflows are effectively rolled out, documented, and adopted.
  • Engage Revenue team members as partners in testing new processes and tools, and incorporate their feedback into solutions.

Documentation & Operational Excellence

  • Create and maintain clear documentation for tools, systems, processes, workflows, and automations.
  • Ensure documentation is accessible and easy for Revenue teams to understand and use.
  • Partner with Enablement to support training and adoption of new tools and processes.
  • Establish repeatable processes that make it easier for teams to understand and consistently use Revenue systems.

What You'll Bring:

  • 4+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Marketing Operations, or Customer Success Operations.
  • Hands-on HubSpot administration experience across Marketing Hub and Sales Hub.
  • Experience owning, implementing, and optimizing Revenue technology and GTM systems such as CRM, conversation intelligence, sales engagement, communication, customer education, and payment platforms.
  • Strong understanding of Revenue processes and how systems, data, and workflows support the broader GTM motion.
  • Experience building and optimizing workflows, automations, integrations, and data flows.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to use data to identify problems, inform decisions, and measure impact.
  • Demonstrated experience evaluating or implementing AI-powered GTM tools — not just familiarity, but hands-on work with AI-assisted workflows, automation platforms, or agentic tooling.
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to independently drive initiatives from concept through implementation.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, agile, and dynamic environment where priorities can change quickly.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with stakeholders at all levels.

title: Principal AI Engineer
description_html:
Back in 2012, we were a group of engineers and designers who decided we wanted to build things—so we did. Able started as an engineering and product hub building for a portfolio of early-stage startups. We built many relationships while developing products that were thoughtful, effective, and genuinely useful. But, since then, we’ve grown… and so has our ambition.

Now, we’re entering our next chapter—defined by applied AI. AI is a powerful force in the end-to-end software development cycle, and we’re creating practices that allow us to deliver software fast and more effectively than traditional approaches, creating meaningful value for our partners. Today, our builder mindset is driving us to become an AI-native organization across every function. We’re still evolving, and that’s part of the opportunity. If you want to build, learn, and tackle challenges alongside an ambitious team, let’s build together.

This position is 100% remote within LatAm.

About the Role

As our Principal AI Engineer, you will lead the design and implementation of production AI systems that solve real business problems for our partners and shape how Able builds. You were a Technical Founder, Co-founder, or founding engineer at an AI company. You have the scar tissue of taking something to market and learning why product-market fit is hard. You will set the technical bar for AI at Able, working at the spec and acceptance layer of an AI-native engineering model, and play a key role in establishing Able as a leader in the AI space.

What We’re Looking For

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

  • Technical Leadership: you will lead technical conversations, be hands-on in building applications or proofs of concepts, and establish AI/ML guidelines and standards for our partners, prospects, and across the organization.
  • Entrepreneurship: you will spot market opportunities to match technology with business outcomes, bringing a builder's instinct for what will and won't land commercially.
  • AI Thought Leadership and Innovation: you will drive Able's AI strategy forward by constantly exploring and implementing cutting-edge AI technologies, frameworks, and tools.
  • Consulting/Business Development: you will work with partners and prospects to understand their business and conceive of opportunities to introduce technology (AI specifically) to improve performance.
  • AI Enablement: you will provide coaching and mentorship, continuously enhancing our team's and partner teams AI capabilities through knowledge sharing and training on the latest technology and best practices.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 12+ years building AI/ML systems, with production experience shipping and operating them
  • Fluency with the modern LLM stack: frontier models, RAG, vector databases, agentic frameworks, and the evals and guardrails that make them trustworthy in production
  • You operate in the spec-and-harness model, leveraging agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.,) at the spec and acceptance layer
  • Demonstrated experience leading large and complex projects
  • Proven experience integrating ML and generative models with existing web and mobile applications
  • Innate ability to effectively interact and inspire our partners and executive stakeholders on new AI ideas
  • Demonstrated skill in connecting business challenges to the potential benefits of AI, and effectively communicating those opportunities to non-technical audiences
  • Excellent English verbal and written communication

Nice to Have

  • Master's or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, with a strong focus on AI and Machine Learning
  • Experience with MCP, graph-based retrieval, or multimodal pipelines

Able is powered by curious, thoughtful people who care about what they build and how they build it. We’re actively investing in our team through AI training, knowledge-sharing, and hands-on experimentation to ensure everyone grows alongside the technology.

This position is 100% remote within LatAm. Strong verbal and written communication skills in English are a requirement. As a team member, you can expect:

  • To work 40 hours per week, and be available during normal business hours as needed.
  • Payments made in USD.
  • 18 days of PTO per year, observance of local holidays, and an annual break between Christmas and New Years.
  • Wellness + Remote Stipend
  • AI Voucher

About Able

Able builds technology products in a portfolio model. We believe that people, teams, and processes are more important than the ideas themselves, so we’ve focused on bringing great people together, and investing in their growth.

We’ve built products in a variety of industries. Everything from media to finance to toys to healthcare. Sometimes we work with management teams to help their businesses grow faster or unlock value using technology. Other times we start or buy businesses outright. Each time, we look for opportunities to leverage technology built at the portfolio-level to drive value faster.

Able is committed to inclusion and diversity and is an equal-opportunity employer. All applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

This is but the beginning of a conversation we’d love to have with you.

Apply, and let’s get this adventure started!

title: Director, Paid Search
description_html:
The Role

We’re looking for a Director to join the rapidly expanding team that is the backbone of our company. You’ll directly manage a team of paid search experts that run search engine marketing (SEM) campaigns across both Google Ads and Microsoft Ads. Your complex portfolio of clients will be fast-paced and high-growth clients that constantly challenge you, and with extensive experience and/or a proven track record, you could be working with some of our most complex and fastest-growing brands. You’ll be trusted to oversee a growing portfolio of business, collaborate with other paid search directors to keep the paid search department running smoothly, and provide thought leadership to keep Wpromote Paid Search at the forefront.

At Wpromote, we believe that great work is only possible with great people. Our goal is to build a better, more inclusive work environment and support our people at every stage of their careers by prioritizing a strong work-life balance through our policies and benefits listed below. As a Best Place to Work according to both Ad Age and Glassdoor and Adweek’s Fastest Growing Digital Agency, we are moving fast to expand our teams and bring new experts into the fold to keep pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in marketing.

We offer:

-Remote-first culture

-Unlimited PTO

-Extended Holiday break (Winter)

-Flexible schedules

-Work from anywhere options*

-100% paid parental leave

-401(k) matching

-Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Pet Insurance

-Sponsored life insurance

-Short Term Disability insurance and additional voluntary insurance

-Annual Class Pass credits and more!

The anticipated annual salary for this role will range from $120,000 - $130,000, based on consideration of a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years and depth of experience, education and certifications, competitive benchmarks, scope of responsibility, market dynamics, geographic location, and respective state’s salary threshold for exempt employees. The total compensation package for this role will include benefits (listed above) and an annual performance bonus.

This role has an associated annual target bonus component which is paid out based on a number of factors which include Company performance, department performance, and individual performance. Bonuses are not guaranteed and you must be an active employee in good standing and not on a Performance Improvement Plan to be eligible for the annual bonus.

*This position may be performed remotely in most states within the US, with some exclusions

**While this role offers the flexibility to work remotely, we have office hubs in Los Angeles, Chicago, and New York, where you can join in on learning and development opportunities, fun events, take advantage of a space to work, and collaborate in person!

***This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship

Important Notice: Beware of Job Scams

Wpromote recruiting communications will only be sent through our official channels via wpromote.com email addresses. If you see a posting elsewhere that is not reflected on Wpromote.com/careers, it may be a fraudulent posting. We do not require payment or fees during the hiring process nor do we request sensitive information, such as Social Security numbers or payment details. Please safeguard yourself against possible scams and contact us if you encounter any suspicious activity.

You Will Be

  • Leading and developing a team of 4–5 Paid Search Managers and Associate Directors, providing strategic guidance, coaching, and professional development support
  • Overseeing a portfolio of enterprise Paid Search clients, ensuring flawless execution, retention, growth, innovation, and strategic alignment across accounts
  • Driving integrated, data-informed Paid Search strategies that align to client business objectives, cross-channel initiatives, and overall digital marketing goals
  • Serving as a senior strategic partner and leadership presence across client relationships, providing oversight on recommendations, deliverables, escalations, and long-term growth opportunities
  • Partnering cross-functionally with Client Services, Paid Media leadership, and channel teams to identify opportunities for account growth, operational efficiency, and integrated media strategies
  • Establishing and maintaining testing frameworks, innovation roadmaps, and thought leadership initiatives to evolve client performance and advance Paid Search best practices
  • Ensuring quality assurance, operational excellence, and adherence to department processes and standards across the account portfolio
  • Supporting onboarding and mentorship across the Paid Search team, including training on strategy, communication, business acumen, and platform expertise
  • Contributing to department operations, resource management, process improvements, and strategic initiatives to support continued team and business growth
  • Acting as a strategic advisor to Paid Search leadership by proactively surfacing account opportunities, business risks, team insights, and recommendations
  • Supporting new business initiatives through audits, pitches, and strategic recommendations for prospective Paid Search clients
  • Maintaining expertise across Paid Search and broader digital marketing channels, including Paid Social, SEO, Content Marketing, Programmatic, and Email Marketing
  • In select cases, directly managing high-profile accounts to stay current on evolving technologies, platform capabilities, and industry trends while testing and scaling new strategies across the department
  • Serving as a thought leader on AI and the evolution of search, collaborating with the SEO team to translate emerging trends into holistic search strategies and actionable recommendations for clients

You Must Have

  • 7+ years of experience working in paid media advertising comprising of media planning/buying in paid search within an agency/client environment
  • 2+ years prior staff management with development and mentoring experience, as well as the ability to navigate difficult personnel situations and conflicts
  • Extensive experience developing, optimizing, analyzing, and reporting on paid search campaigns
  • Experience with data analytical tools such as Google Analytics
  • Strong working experience in Google suite, Excel, Asana (project management)
  • Experience with creating paid search customer acquisition campaigns for a diverse range of clients and verticals (multi-location and lead gen preferred)
  • Excellent oral, written, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to identify and respond to situations quickly

title: Principal Security Engineer, Infrastructure Security
description_html:
About the Team

Security is at the foundation of OpenAI’s mission to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity.

The Security team protects OpenAI’s technology, people, and products. We are technical in what we build but are operational in how we do our work, and are committed to supporting all products and research at OpenAI. Our Security team tenets include: prioritizing for impact, enabling researchers, preparing for future transformative technologies, and engaging a robust security culture.

About the Role

OpenAI is seeking a Principal Security Engineer to join our Infrastructure Security (InfraSec) team. InfraSec protects the foundations of OpenAI’s research and production environments, spanning GPU supercomputing clusters, multi-cloud infrastructure, datacenters, networking, storage, and the critical services that power our frontier AI models. Our charter includes securing everything from bare-metal hardware and firmware, to Kubernetes clusters and service meshes, to data storage and access pathways for highly sensitive model weights and user data.

As a principal engineer, you will set technical direction and drive execution on high-impact infrastructure security programs, partnering across various orgs at OpenAI to deliver durable controls that raise the security bar at OpenAI scale.

In this role, you will:

  • Own end-to-end security outcomes for one or more critical infrastructure areas, including multi-quarter strategy, roadmap, and delivery.

  • Design and build security controls across diverse layers (e.g., physical hardware, firmware/BMC, OS, Kubernetes, networks, and CI/CD) to defend against sophisticated adversaries and insider threats.

  • Lead cross-functional programs to deploy security enhancements and control changes across broad-scale infrastructure, balancing security guarantees with reliability and velocity.

  • Take a generalist approach to building security controls, balancing a mix of security expertise and broad technical skillsets to adapt to evolving challenges.

  • Lead and/or drive threat modeling and design reviews for major infrastructure changes, ensuring strong security foundations and operational excellence.

  • Mentor and level up engineers across InfraSec and partner teams, contributing to a strong security culture through guidance, reviews, and technical leadership.

You will thrive in this role if you have:

  • Deep understanding of security principles, best practices, and common vulnerabilities, including strong security judgment under ambiguity

  • A proactive mindset, with the ability to identify and address security gaps or inefficiencies through automation and tooling.

  • Expertise and curiosity about using frontier models and agents to effectively solve security challenges.

  • A track record of leading large, cross-org initiatives from concept to rollout, including navigating tradeoffs, driving alignment, and delivering measurable risk reduction.

  • Deep expertise in the security of cloud platforms (e.g., Amazon AWS, Microsoft Azure), especially securing multi-cloud networks and infrastructure, and designing cloud-agnostic systems.

  • Experience securing on-prem deployments and datacenters from construction to multi-tenant use.

  • Familiarity with container security, orchestration security, and authentication/authorization.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an ability to think critically and objectively assess security risks.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to convey complex security concepts to executive, technical, and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Excitement about collaborating with cross-functional teams to build secure, reliable systems that scale globally.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

In pursuit of this mission, our Go To Market (GTM) team is responsible for helping customers learn how to leverage and deploy our highly capable AI products across their business. The team is made of Sales, Solutions, Support, Marketing, and Partnership professionals that work together to create valuable solutions that will help bring AI to as many users as possible.

About the role

Our Sales team has a unique mission to help customers understand the deep impact that highly capable AI models can bring to their business and users. This role is a mixture of technical understanding, vision, partnership, and value-driven strategy.

You’ll be a key driver of new business opportunities through the entire sales cycle, from pipeline generation to closure. You’ll work with researchers, engineers, and solution strategists to help customers evolve their industry with AI.

This role can be based in our San Francisco, New York, or Seattle offices. We are also considering applications to work remotely from within the U.S. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

  • Own a consumption revenue target

  • Collaborate with solutions, marketing, communications, business operations, people operations, finance, product management, and engineering

  • Support the recruitment and onboarding of other teammates

You build strong relationships with executives and professionals across functions and serve as a trusted advisor.

Wir lieben E-Commerce und haben uns deshalb zur Aufgabe gemacht, unseren Kund:innen in diesem interessanten, dynamischen Bereich als langfristiger Partner zur Seite zu stehen.

Unser Team aus E-Commerce Expert:innen und motivierten Professionals kümmert sich um die Entwicklung von Shopify Shops, Einrichtung und Optimierung von ERP Systemen wie PlentyONE (ehemals plentymarkets) und die Programmierung individueller Softwarelösungen.

Aus unseren Standorten in Hamburg & Dortmund stehen wir unseren Kund:innen täglich mit geballter E-Commerce Expertise zur Seite und entwickeln individuelle Lösungen für ihre Herausforderungen im schnelllebigen E-Commerce Dschungel.

Damit wir unsere vielen Projekte unter einen Hut bekommen und unseren Kund:innen weiter Top Service bieten zu können, suchen wir ab sofort eine/n motivierte/n Web-Entwickler:in für Shopify und PlentyONE Projekte.

Aufgaben

Zu Beginn gibt's bei uns ein intensives, optimiertes Onboarding, das dich auf die spannende Arbeit mit unseren Kund:innen perfekt vorbereitet.

  • Web-Apps: Du entwickelst kleine Web-Apps mit PHP (Vanilla PHP oder Laravel) und Frontend Frameworks/Libraries wie React, Angular 2 oder Vue
  • Script-Entwicklung: Du entwickelst Scripte um E-Commerce Daten zwischen verschiedenen API's auszutauschen oder große Datenmengen zu verarbeiten.
  • Nach tiefgehender Einarbeitung unterstützt du uns in der Entwicklung von Shopify Apps und plentymarkets Plugins

Qualifikation

Wir sind Fans von familiärem Arbeitsklima - das klappt aber nur, wenn alle Mitziehen und motiviert sind. Du solltest vor allem Leidenschaft und ein hohes Maß an Eigeninitiative mitbringen

  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit PHP.
  • Du bist mit mindestens einem Frontend Framework wie React, Angular oder Vue vertraut.
  • Du entwickelst leidenschaftlich Software und schreckst nicht vor Herausforderungen zurück.
  • Du kannst Projekte zügig und effizient abschließen und behältst auch in einem dynamischen Agenturumfeld stets die Ruhe.
  • Du hast bestenfalls Erfahrung im Umgang mit Shopify, PlentyONE oder anderen E-Commerce und ERP Systemen**.**
  • Du bist kommunikationsstark und hast Spaß am Umgang mit Menschen.
  • Tools wie Slack, monday.com und asana sind für dich keine Fremdwörter.

Benefits

title: Creative Strategist (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at BodyFokus GmbH
description_html:
Du entwickelst Hooks, Angles und Advertorials, die bei Cold Traffic verkaufen - und misst deine Ideen daran, was konvertiert, nicht daran, wie schön sie aussehen? Du testest strukturiert, iterierst Gewinner und tötest Verlierer ohne Wehmut? Dann lies weiter.

Wir bei BodyFokus sind der Longevity-Lebensbegleiter für Mensch und Hund. Über unsere Marken BodyFokus, BeautyFokus und PetFokus helfen wir mehr als 250.000 Menschen und ihren Hunden im DACH-Raum, ihre Gesundheit aktiv in die Hand zu nehmen. Wir sind schnell, ergebnisorientiert und haben wenig übrig für Bürokratie - am Ende zählt das Ergebnis, nicht der vorgeschriebene Weg dorthin.

Als Creative Strategist bist du der Kreativ-Motor unserer Neukundengewinnung. Bei uns entscheiden Hook und Angle über den Großteil der Performance - der Rest ist Ausführung. Über alle drei Marken hinweg entwickelst du die Advertorials und UGC-Konzepte, die kalten Traffic in Kunden verwandeln - Hand in Hand mit dem Team.

Bei uns läuft alles AI- und Agent-gestützt: Du nutzt KI und eigene Agenten-Workflows als Hebel für Tempo und Menge - Varianten und Copy im Akkord - und filterst die besten Ideen mit klarem Urteil heraus. Die KI ist dein Hebel, nicht deine Ausrede.

Aufgaben

  • Creative Strategy & Angles: Hooks, Angles und Advertorial-Konzepte über BodyFokus, BeautyFokus und PetFokus entwickeln, die bei Cold Traffic auf Meta und Co. stoppen und verkaufen.
  • Ad-Konzepte: Konzepte für Bild- und Video-Ads entwickeln, Creator, Designer und Cutter briefen und steuern.
  • Angles aus echten Daten: Reviews, Support-Anfragen und CRM-Gespräche nach echten Pain Points, der Sprache der Kunden und ungenutzten Zielgruppen durchforsten - deine Angles kommen aus Daten, nicht aus dem Bauch.
  • Creative Testing: feste Taktung neuer Angles und Varianten pro Woche. Gewinner iterieren, müde Creatives abschalten - gemessen an Hook-Rate, CTR, CVR und dem Effekt auf den CAC.
  • Creative Review: Du wertest vergangene Creatives systematisch aus, statt nur den nächsten Test zu starten. Aus Gewinnern und Verlierern liest du Muster heraus — welcher Pain Point trägt, welche Formulierung stoppt, welche Audience auf welches Versprechen reagiert — und schärfst damit laufend den Fit zwischen Audience und Produkt. Jede Testrunde startet klüger als die letzte.
  • Schulter an Schulter mit Paid: eng mit dem Team arbeiten, damit Anzeige, Advertorial und Produktseite als Einheit funktionieren.
  • KI & Agenten-Workflows: eigene AI- und Agenten-Prozesse aufsetzen, die Recherche, Varianten und Auswertung beschleunigen.

Qualifikation

  • Direct-Response-Creative aus eigener Praxis: Du hast Hooks, Angles und Advertorials konzipiert, die bei Cold Traffic verkauft haben - und kannst deine Zahlen benennen (Winning-Rate, CTR, CVR, Effekt auf den CAC).
  • Advertorial- und Copy-Handwerk: Du kennst die Klaviatur - problembewusste Hooks, Open Loops, hohe Neugier - und weißt, wie ein Advertorial bei Cold Traffic verkauft und woran ein Hook scheitert. Aus eigener Erfahrung, nicht aus Plattform-Guidelines.
  • Creative plus Zahlen: Du beurteilst Creatives danach, was konvertiert, nicht danach, was gefällt.
  • Tempo vor Perfektion: Du produzierst lieber viele Angles und lässt den Markt entscheiden, statt ewig am "perfekten" Creative zu feilen. Du weißt: Man muss auch mal schlecht sein, um richtig gut zu werden.
  • Consumer-Gespür und AI-first: Du triffst, was Gesundheits-, Beauty- und Hunde-KundInnen zum Klicken und Kaufen bringt, und nutzt KI als Hebel dafür.
  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch, fließendes Englisch.

Wichtig: Bei uns steht Performance an erster Stelle, und unsere Funnel sind Verkaufsgespräche, kein Markenschaufenster. Handwerk und Ästhetik gehören dazu - aber auf dem Fundament der Zahl. Wenn dein Zuhause klassisches Marken-, Design- oder Award-Creative ohne Verantwortung dafür ist, was am Ende verkauft, ist das nicht die richtige Rolle für dich.

Du deckst nicht jeden Punkt ab, bringst aber nachweisbar Creatives mit, die verkauft haben? Bewirb dich trotzdem - überzeug uns mit Beispielen und Zahlen.

Benefits

  • Echter kreativer Gestaltungsraum ab Tag eins: Du besitzt die Creative-Seite unserer Akquise - kurze Wege, direkter Draht zur Marketingleitung, deine Ideen gehen live statt in Gremien.
  • Ein Geschäft, das funktioniert: profitabel skalierend, drei Marken, hunderttausende KundInnen - dein Creative wirkt sofort und messbar.
  • Attraktive Vergütung.
  • Homeoffice & Bürotage im Mix - deshalb bevorzugen wir Bewerber:innen aus dem Kölner Raum.

Unser Prozess enthält ein paar durchdachte Fragen und eine kleine Kreativ-Probe - wir wollen sehen, wie du denkst und Angles findest, nicht nur, was in deinem Lebenslauf steht. Wir freuen uns auf dich!

title: Creative Strategist (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Next Lotto GmbH
description_html:
Ein kleines Stück Papier mit Zahlen, die das Potenzial haben, ein Leben für immer zu verändern! Ok…ersetzten wir das Papier durch eine App und eine Person gegen 600.000+ Nutzer monatlich. This is our Business!

📌 Deine Mission

Als Creative Strategist (m/w/d) verwandelst du Performance-daten in die Roadmap für Creative-Tests. Du entscheidest, was getestet wird, warum es getestet wird, und briefst die Producers, damit unsere Creative-Engine schnell lernt und den CAC nachhaltig senkt. Du bildest die Brücke zwischen den Daten des Media-Teams und dem Output des Creative-Teams: Du bist die Person, die sicherstellt, dass wir nicht nur Masse produzieren, sondern genau die richtige Masse.

Aufgaben

  • Werbemittel-Performance gemeinsam mit dem User-Acquisition- und Daten-Team analysieren; identifizieren, was funktioniert und warum.
  • Konzepte, Hooks, Angles und Formate entwickeln; die Testing-Roadmap sowie die Priorisierung eigenverantwortlich steuern.
  • Das Producer-Team mit klaren, messbaren und testbaren Creative-Briefings anleiten.
  • Markt-, Wettbewerbs- und Trend-Analysen durchführen (TikTok, Meta sowie branchenspezifische Channels).
  • Erkenntnisse aus der Performance-Analyse direkt in die nächste Creative-Produktion einfließen lassen.
  • Eng mit Media Buying, Produktion, Copywriting und Brand Management zusammenarbeiten – unter strikter Einhaltung der rechtlichen Rahmenbedingungen (z. B. GlüStV).

Deine Ziele in dieser Rolle (Impact):

  • Strukturiertes Testing-System aufbauen: Ein klares Framework für Creative-Tests entwickeln – von der Hypothese über die Formate bis zur Test-Sequenzierung.
  • Datengestützte Ideation: Systematisch neue Hooks, Konzepte und Blickwinkel (Angles) auf Basis von Leistungsdaten und aktuellen Trends entwickeln.
  • Performance steigern: Die Erfolgsquote von Gewinner-Creatives erhöhen sowie CTR, Hook-Rate und Conversion-Rate im Paid Marketing nachhaltig verbessern.
  • Wissensdatenbank aufbauen: Eine Lern-Bibliothek für Creatives pflegen, damit Erkenntnisse langfristig wachsen, statt bei jedem Test verloren zu gehen.
  • Produktion beschleunigen: Den Prozess vom Briefing bis zum fertigen Test-Creative gemeinsam mit den Producers deutlich verkürzen.

Qualifikation

Must-have:

  • Tiefes Verständnis für Paid-Social-Creatives (insbesondere Meta und TikTok).
  • Fähigkeit, Ad-Performance-Kennzahlen zu lesen und direkt in strategische Creative-Entscheidungen zu übersetzen.
  • Starke Fähigkeiten in der Entwicklung von Konzepten und Aufhängern (Hooks).

title: Marketing Manager (m/w/d) – Beauty & Medical
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Adam & Eve Beautylounge GmbH
description_html:
Wir suchen...

Für unsere beiden Marken Adam & Eve Beauty und Adam & Eve Medical suchen wir einen Marketing Manager (m/w/d), der Lust hat, zwei unterschiedliche Markenwelten aktiv weiterzuentwickeln.

Beauty ist emotional, schnell, trendgetrieben und nah an Social Media. Medical braucht Vertrauen, Expertise, hochwertige Kommunikation und ein feines Gespür für medizinische Ästhetik.

Du verstehst diesen Unterschied – und weißt gleichzeitig, wie aus einer starken Marke Reichweite, relevante Leads, Neukunden und langfristige Kundenbindung entstehen.

Wir suchen keinen reinen Verwalter, sondern jemanden, der mitdenkt, Ideen entwickelt, Verantwortung übernimmt und Dinge ins Machen bringt.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Entwicklung und Umsetzung der Marketingstrategie für Adam & Eve Beauty und Adam & Eve Medical
  • Planung und Steuerung von Kampagnen über alle relevanten Kanäle
  • Entwicklung von Content-, Social-Media- und Kampagnenkonzepten
  • Planung von Aktionen, Promotions, Produkt- und Behandlungslaunches
  • Steuerung von Social Media sowie Foto- und Video-Produktionen
  • Zusammenarbeit mit Creators, Influencern, Agenturen und externen Partnern
  • Weiterentwicklung unserer Websites, Landingpages und digitalen Customer Journey
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Performance Marketing
  • Entwicklung von Maßnahmen zur Neukundengewinnung, Kundenaktivierung und Kundenbindung
  • Unterstützung unserer Standorte bei lokalen Marketingmaßnahmen
  • Analyse relevanter KPIs und kontinuierliche Optimierung unserer Aktivitäten
  • Beobachtung von Beauty-, Medical-, Social-Media- und digitalen Marketingtrends
  • Sicherstellung eines klaren und hochwertigen Markenauftritts beider Marken

Soft Skills:

  • Du bist kreativ, hast aber gleichzeitig einen hohen Anspruch an Struktur und Umsetzung.
  • Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für Ästhetik, Marken und Zielgruppen.
  • Du denkst unternehmerisch und möchtest verstehen, was eine Kampagne tatsächlich bewirkt.
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig und übernimmst Verantwortung.
  • Du kannst mehrere Projekte und Themen gleichzeitig organisieren, ohne den Überblick zu verlieren.
  • Du bist kommunikativ und kannst interne Teams sowie externe Partner zusammenbringen.
  • Du bringst eigene Ideen ein und wartest nicht darauf, dass dir jeder nächste Schritt vorgegeben wird.
  • Du hast Lust auf ein dynamisches Umfeld, in dem nicht alles schon seit zehn Jahren genauso gemacht wird.

Hard Skills:

  • Berufserfahrung im Marketing, idealerweise 1**–2 Jahre**
  • Erfahrung im Brand-, Digital- oder Content-Marketing
  • Sehr gutes Verständnis von Instagram, TikTok und aktuellen Social-Media-Formaten
  • Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Umsetzung von Marketingkampagnen
  • Verständnis für Performance Marketing, Paid Social und relevante Marketing-KPIs
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Content- und Redaktionsplanung
  • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Creators, Influencern und Agenturen
  • Grundverständnis für Websites, Landingpages, Conversion und Customer Journey
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und ein sicheres Gefühl für Sprache und Tonalität
  • Erfahrung im Bereich Beauty, Kosmetik, Lifestyle, Healthcare oder Medical Aesthetics ist ein großes Plus

Das bieten wir dir:

Hier würde ich nicht die üblichen austauschbaren „flachen Hierarchien und Obstkorb“-Sätze schreiben.

Bei Adam & Eve bekommst du echten Gestaltungsspielraum und Verantwortung für zwei Marken, die sich in unterschiedlichen Märkten bewegen und gleichzeitig viele Synergien bieten.

Du arbeitest nah an der Geschäftsführung, hast kurze Entscheidungswege und kannst deine Ideen nicht nur präsentieren, sondern auch umsetzen.

Dich erwarten:

  • Verantwortung für zwei etablierte Markenwelten
  • viel Raum für eigene Ideen und neue Marketingansätze
  • kurze Entscheidungswege und direkter Austausch mit der Geschäftsführung
  • ein dynamisches Umfeld zwischen Beauty, Medical Aesthetics, Social Media und digitalem Marketing
  • die Möglichkeit, Markenentwicklung und Wachstum sichtbar mitzugestalten
  • ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld in Hamburg
  • Mitarbeitervorteile rund um unsere Beauty- und Medical-Angebote

So sieht ein Arbeitsalltag für dich aus:

Dein Tag kann mit der Auswertung einer laufenden Kampagne beginnen und eine Stunde später sitzt du mit unserem Team an der Idee für einen neuen Medical-Launch.

Du koordinierst Content, besprichst eine Produktion mit einem Creator, optimierst gemeinsam mit unseren Partnern eine Kampagne und überlegst, wie wir aus einem aktuellen Beauty-Trend eine relevante Idee für Adam & Eve entwickeln können.

Dabei geht es bei uns nicht darum, einfach möglichst viel Content zu produzieren.

Wir wollen Marketing machen, das auffällt, zur jeweiligen Marke passt und am Ende auch funktioniert.

Und genau dafür bekommst du bei uns den notwendigen Gestaltungsspielraum.

Kontaktinformationen

Du möchtest nicht nur Marketing verwalten, sondern Marken mitgestalten?

Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Bewirb dich direkt über unser Karriereportal und erzähl uns gerne, welche Marken, Kampagnen oder Projekte du bisher begleitet hast.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

title: Account Development Representative - France
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Samsara
description_html:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role

As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive. 

On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our EMEA business, generating opportunities via outbound outreach. 

We have offices in Paris and London and we offer remote working from Germany, France and the United Kingdom.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in France, Germany, and the United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CEST. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.
  • You love talking to people: In this role, you will average 60+ calls to prospective customers daily.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.
  • You treat rejection as a learning experience: In this role, you will get hung up on and you will get told no. You need to have the resilience to pick up the phone again and again to sell Samsara's mission.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will: 

  • Drive pipeline through personalized outreach to prospects via phone, emails and LinkedIn
  • Have the opportunity to to participate in trade/shows events to represent the Samsara brand and connect with prospective customers and partners.
  • Become a product expert and learn the Samsara way of selling
  • Keep meticulous records of interactions with accounts in our CRM (Salesforce.com)
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 1-3 years professional experience, ideally in customer facing roles
  • 6-12 months sales experience as a minimum
  • Highly motivated and committed, with strong desire to work in target driven sales
  • Proven track record of consistent over achievement of targets/expectations of previous roles
  • Excellent communication skills, verbal and written
  • Curious and able to ask insightful questions
  • A champion of a Growth Mindset
  • Highly proficient in English and in French

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience in closing-sales roles
  • Proven track record of achievements beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity, …)
  • Willingness to collaborate and influence in a "win as a team" environment
  • Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space

ADR pathways

Through Samsara's ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility during the program and beyond—those who work hard to grow quickly will have the opportunity to advance their careers. With emphasis on continued professional development, the training doesn't stop after onboarding—we provide opportunities to expand ADRs' understanding of the market and our competitors, develop hard skills needed in the Sales function, and work with mentors to help our representatives progress through the three levels of our ADR program.

  • ADR I representatives focus on inbound leads—conducting a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with those prospects interested in Samsara. At the ADR I level, we provide plenty of learning opportunities including call sessions with more senior Sales team members, training on tools (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, objection handling, and more. Our representatives at this level are go-getters who are able to progress their careers through the opportunities provided for them.
  • The next level in the program is ADR II, where our representatives work on top of funnel movement, creating high quality sales engagements, and supporting our Account Executives. Along with the leap into outbound work, those at the ADR II level are continually exposed to learning opportunities and enrolled in specialized trainings including professional writing, persona based messaging, , cold calling 2.0, and collaboration and communication with Account Executives. After building their skills in outbound sales and earning sales certifications, our representatives graduate to the final level of the program.
  • The highest level within our organization is ADR III. These ADRs work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers at Samsara. They partner closely on large accounts, implementing detailed territory plans, participating in weekly strategy meetings, and scheduling and attending customer demos. Additionally, ADR IIIs partake in a mentorship program to learn from leadership on the Account Executive team who provide exposure and training ahead of their interview for an Account Executive position.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Lighting Design Lead
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Neko Health
description_html:
Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Role Purpose

The Lighting Design Lead will own the development and stewardship of Neko Health’s global lighting design standards — shaping how lighting supports the member experience, clinical function, and architectural identity across every Neko location worldwide. Working within the Architecture Creative Leads team, this role sits at the intersection of lighting design, spatial experience, and product development.

Your primary focus is establishing a scalable, globally consistent lighting strategy that defines how every Neko space feels the moment someone walks in. You will develop lighting standards for the Location Design Playbook, drive lighting innovation for next-generation scanning environments and clinic typologies and provide concept-level creative guidance to regional design teams delivering projects globally.

This role reports to the Architecture Creative Studio Lead and partners closely with the Architecture Design Studio Leads for the US and Europe, the Industrial Design Lead, and cross-functional teams in Arts and Graphics, Hardware, Medical Excellence, and Operations.

What You’ll Deliver in the First 6–12 Months

  • A comprehensive global lighting design standard is documented in the Location Design Playbook, covering all key clinic zones (scan rooms, consultation areas, waiting areas, circulation, and back-of-house) ready for regional teams to implement consistently.

  • Concept-level lighting guidance on at least two active regional projects, ensuring alignment with Neko’s design direction and experience principles while respecting local conditions.

  • Become a brand guardian for the lighting strategy, supporting Architecture Design Leads in the review and feedback of consultant documentation.

  • Established strong relationships with key cross-functional partners (i.e. Hardware, Software, Medical Excellence, Operations, and external lighting consultants) so that lighting decisions are informed, collaborative, and technically sound.

Minimum Requirements

  • Degree in Lighting Design, Architecture, Interior Design, or a related field.

  • 8+ years of experience in architectural lighting design, with a portfolio demonstrating layered, human-centred lighting across a range of project types.

  • Demonstrated experience developing lighting standards, guidelines, or playbooks for a multi-site, global or scaling organisation.

  • Deep understanding of lighting technology i.e. LED systems, controls and integration with building management systems.

  • Experience collaborating with architects, interior designers, and engineering teams to integrate lighting seamlessly into spatial design.

  • Proficiency in lighting design software (e.g., DIALux, Relux, AGi32) and familiarity with rendering tools for visualizing lighting concepts.

  • Strong understanding of relevant lighting standards and codes (e.g., EN 12464, WELL Building Standard lighting criteria, healthcare-specific requirements).

  • Excellent communication skills — able to articulate lighting intent to both creative and technical audiences, and comfortable presenting to leadership.

  • Comfort operating in a fast-growing, scaling environment where standards are still being built and processes are evolving.

  • Alignment with Neko’s studio culture: enablers not heroes, creative problem solvers, craft-driven.


Preferred

  • Familiarity with lighting for branded retail, hospitality, or experiential environments at scale.

  • Experience in developing interactive lighting solutions.

  • Experience specifying and procuring lighting products for multi-site rollout, including vendor management and cost optimization.

  • Knowledge of sustainability considerations in lighting — energy efficiency, lifecycle costs, and circular design principles.

description_html:
Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Role Purpose

The FF+E Design Lead will own the development and stewardship of Neko Health’s global furniture, fixtures, equipment, and accessories strategy — defining the physical objects, materials, and product selections that shape the member experience across every Neko location worldwide.

Working within the Architecture Creative Leads team, this role sits at the intersection of interior design, physical user experience, and procurement strategy. Your primary focus is establishing a scalable, globally consistent FF+E standard that ensures every Neko space feels considered, cohesive, and unmistakably Neko.

You will develop FF+E and accessories standards for the Location Design Playbook, drive product development and selection and provide concept-level creative guidance to regional design teams delivering projects globally.

This role reports to the Architecture Creative Studio Lead and partners closely with the Architecture Design Studio Leads for the US and Europe, the Industrial Design Lead, and cross-functional teams in Hardware, Operations, Brand, and Procurement.

What You’ll Deliver in the First 6–12 Months

  • Comprehensive global standards, documented in the Location Design Playbook — covering furniture, fixtures, accessories, for all key clinic zones — with clear specifications, product lists, and sourcing guidance ready for regional teams to implement.

  • A scalable procurement and vendor strategy for FF+E, with preferred suppliers identified globally and regionally, supporting consistent quality, cost efficiency, and lead-time reliability across markets.

  • Concept-level FF+E guidance on at least two active regional projects, ensuring selections align with Neko’s design language and experience principles while adapting to local availability and requirements.

  • Contribute to the development of bespoke FF+E and accessory items that cannot be sourced off-the-shelf — collaborating with the Industrial Design Lead and external vendors to develop proprietary solutions that reinforce the Neko brand.

Minimum Requirements

  • Degree in Interior Design, Product Design, Furniture Design, Industrial Design, Architecture, or related field.

  • 8+ years of experience in FF+E design, specification, and procurement, with a portfolio demonstrating a strong eye for material quality, detail, and cohesive design language.

  • Demonstrated experience developing FF+E standards, product libraries, or specification playbooks for a multi-site, global or scaling organization.

  • A keen eye for colour, material and finishes.

Role Purpose

This is not a traditional laboratory role. We're looking for a Biomedical Scientist who is comfortable working differently, embraces innovation, and takes pride in delivering accurate results at exceptional pace.

Neko Health members come through our London clinics for whole-body preventive health screenings, and our laboratories sit at the centre of the patient journey. They are busy, modern spaces, and the service continues to develop as we scale.

This is a hands-on, autonomous role, based on site in one of our central London laboratories. As a Biomedical Scientist, you will operate our Abbott Alinity and Sysmex XN-550 analysers and support the quality systems that allow us to return results within 30 minutes of sample receipt.

If you're a BMS looking to further develop your career in an innovation-led environment, we would love to hear from you.

What You'll Deliver in the First 6 - 12 Months

  • Initialise the analysers each day and ready them for sample processing.

  • Perform testing on our Abbott Alinity (biochemistry and immunoassay) and Sysmex XN-550 (haematology) analysers, validating patient results and escalating clinically anomalous or unexpected findings.

  • Carry out daily calibration, internal quality control, and routine maintenance of analysers, troubleshooting and escalating technical issues promptly.

  • Work within our ISO 15189-aligned, UKAS-facing quality management system: author SOP updates, monitor EQA performance, support audits, and investigate non-conformances.

  • Contribute to service improvement work, including analyser verification, reagent evaluation, and software testing.

  • Maintain accurate, auditable records and support performance monitoring across turnaround times, KPIs, and consumables usage.

  • Provide technical guidance to clinical colleagues and support training across the lab team.

Minimum Requirements

  • HCPC registration as a Biomedical Scientist, with evidence of ongoing CPD.

  • Minimum one year of post-registration experience in clinical chemistry and immunoassay, including IQC and EQA practice.

  • Demonstrable experience operating an integrated clinical chemistry and immunoassay analyser.

  • Experience working accurately and efficiently under time pressure, suited to a low-volume, fast-turnaround service model.

Preferred

  • Post-registration experience in haematology.

  • Hands-on experience operating Sysmex XN-series haematology analysers.

  • Hands-on experience operating Abbott Alinity ci-series.

  • Experience in POCT, rapid diagnostics, or high-throughput clinical settings.

  • Experience with laboratory information management systems (LIMS), digital result reporting, or involvement in LIMS development and user acceptance testing.

Role Purpose

Neko is scaling fast. Our clinical teams already outnumber HQ across the US and Europe, and that ratio will keep growing. They deliver Neko’s promise to every member, every day – and right now, the information supporting their work is fragmented, inconsistent, and ungoverned. At our current pace, that's not just operational noise. It's a quality and safety risk. The role exists to fix that.

The role sits at the centre of two funnels. Inbound: you'll work closely with every team at Neko to shape what reaches clinical staff, when, and how. That means building trusted relationships across the organisation, helping teams understand what clinical staff need, and together making deliberate decisions about what gets communicated, what waits, and what can be consolidated. Outbound: once aligned and prioritised, you translate that into structured, cadenced formats that a dispersed clinical workforce can act on – right channel, right format, right frequency.

This is change management as much as communications. You're not just sending updates. You're redesigning how the whole organisation relates to its clinical teams.

 

What you'll deliver in the first 6-12 months

Build and enforce the intake model

  • Design the process that governs how every team at Neko communicates with clinical staff – how requests are submitted, evaluated, sequenced, and approved

  • Build the centralised view that ensures nothing reaches clinical staff in an uncoordinated or duplicative way

  • Document decision criteria clearly enough that stakeholders understand and trust how calls are made

  • Define escalation paths for urgent communications that need to move faster than the standard cadence

 

Drive organisation-wide change management

  • Partner with senior leadership to establish the intake model as an endorsed, org-wide norm – not an optional service, but the way Neko works

  • Run a structured roll-out across every team with touch points to clinical staff

  • Build the relationships that make the process feel collaborative rather than bureaucratic

  • Report regularly on intake volume, team compliance, and where we need to evolve.

 

Operationalise clinical communications

  • Start with a clear-eyed audit of how information reaches clinical teams today – the gaps, the overlaps, the friction

  • Build a global clinical programme with a single source of truth that clinical staff can rely on

  • Design the right mix of channels and formats for a dispersed, non-desk workforce – including AI-enabled formats like short-form video, audio briefings, and visual summaries

  • Create repeatable templates that make consistency straightforward for programme managers and local teams

  • Equip clinic leads with the tools and confidence to communicate well within their teams without losing global coherence

  • Define the metrics that prove it's working – comprehension, consistency, engagement, reduction in operational noise – and report on them regularly

  • Build a global communications cadence that helps leadership teams understand what’s changing, what’s ahead and how to prepare.

 

Minimum Qualifications

  • Proven experience in change management, or programme management, with direct ownership of communication or enablement strategy at scale

  • Proven experience designing and enforcing intake or governance processes across multiple cross-functional teams – you've built the model, sold it in, and made it stick

  • A track record running structured communications programmes for large, dispersed frontline workforces

  • Strong programme management instincts: you bring structure to ambiguity and build systems that hold

  • A creative communicator who knows when a policy document is right and when a 60-second video does the job better

  • Genuine fluency with AI tools and an appetite to use them to improve quality, efficiency, and reach

  • Sharp stakeholder skills: you can align leadership and cross-functional teams, hold the line when needed, and build trust in the process

  • Experience in high-growth, multi-site consumer services or healthcare strongly preferred

  • Comfortable working across multiple geographies and time zones

  • Strong written and verbal English; additional European languages a plus

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

Role Purpose

This is not a traditional laboratory role. We're looking for a Biomedical Scientist who is comfortable working differently, embraces innovation, and takes pride in delivering accurate results at exceptional pace.

Neko Health members come through our London clinics for whole-body preventive health screenings, and our laboratories sit at the centre of the patient journey. They are busy, modern spaces, and the service continues to develop as we scale.

This is a hands-on, autonomous role, based on site in one of our central London laboratories. As a Biomedical Scientist, you will operate our Abbott Alinity and Sysmex XN-550 analysers and support the quality systems that allow us to return results within 30 minutes of sample receipt.

If you're a BMS looking to further develop your career in an innovation-led environment, we would love to hear from you.

What You'll Deliver in the First 6 - 12 Months

  • Initialise the analysers each day and ready them for sample processing.

  • Perform testing on our Abbott Alinity (biochemistry and immunoassay) and Sysmex XN-550 (haematology) analysers, validating patient results and escalating clinically anomalous or unexpected findings.

  • Carry out daily calibration, internal quality control, and routine maintenance of analysers, troubleshooting and escalating technical issues promptly.

  • Work within our ISO 15189-aligned, UKAS-facing quality management system: author SOP updates, monitor EQA performance, support audits, and investigate non-conformances.

  • Contribute to service improvement work, including analyser verification, reagent evaluation, and software testing.

  • Maintain accurate, auditable records and support performance monitoring across turnaround times, KPIs, and consumables usage.

  • Provide technical guidance to clinical colleagues and support training across the lab team.

Minimum Requirements

  • HCPC registration as a Biomedical Scientist, with evidence of ongoing CPD.

  • Minimum one year of post-registration experience in clinical chemistry and immunoassay, including IQC and EQA practice.

  • Demonstrable experience operating an integrated clinical chemistry and immunoassay analyser.

  • Experience working accurately and efficiently under time pressure, suited to a low-volume, fast-turnaround service model.

Preferred

  • Post-registration experience in haematology.

  • Hands-on experience operating Sysmex XN-series haematology analysers.

  • Hands-on experience operating Abbott Alinity ci-series.

  • Experience in POCT, rapid diagnostics, or high-throughput clinical settings.

  • Experience with laboratory information management systems (LIMS), digital result reporting, or involvement in LIMS development and user acceptance testing.

title: Senior Research Sonographer
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Neko Health
description_html:
Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Role Purpose

We’re looking for an experienced Ultrasound sonographer to join our multidisciplinary team in Birmingham for 3 days per week and help to take ultrasounds as part of a clinical research study.

This is a key role focused on delivering high-quality, independent assessments. You’ll perform and interpret ultrasound scans of adult women who are receiving a breast ultrasound as part of a clinical study. You will work in conjunction with the principal investigator of the study to ensure that assessments and reports are of research-grade quality. This is a fixed term role that lasts for the duration of the study and is based at our clinics in Birmingham.

What You’ll Deliver

  • Perform high-quality diagnostic ultrasound examinations in line with clinical guidelines and best practices with focus on breast ultrasound

  • Pass on the study-specific acquisition and interpretation qualification task before performing study scans, with certificate filed in the investigational site file.

  • Independently interpret and report ultrasound findings, ensuring timely delivery of results that are uploaded to a standardised electronic case report form.

  • Collaborate with our multidisciplinary research team to help deliver Neko’s clinical trial focused on better understanding risks of breast cancer.

  • Adherence to the study acquisition SOP

  • Equipment QA maintenance logged on-site. Liaise directly with the study PI and research team where needed.

Minimum Requirements

  • HCPC-registered diagnostic radiographer (or other HCPC-/NMC-registered healthcare professional), holding a CASE-accredited postgraduate qualification in breast ultrasound (PgCert / PgDip / MSc, or a named CASE-accredited breast ultrasound module.

  • Documented, current breast ultrasound practice, with a minimum of two years’ full-time-equivalent breast scanning.

  • Advanced radiographic experience of reporting autonomously within the NHS Breast Screening Programme (NHSBSP) or an equivalent quality-assurance framework.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex information clearly to study participants.

  • Commitment to maintaining high clinical standards and engaging in ongoing professional development.

Preferred

  • Experience with previous ultrasound scanning as part of clinical trials

  • Experience with shear-wave elastography acquisition and reporting.

  • Experience with Philips US machines, and decision support software

  • Familiarity with data entry as part of clinical research studies.

title: B2B Sales Lead, UK

description_html:
Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Role Purpose

As UK B2B Lead, you will design and run Neko's first B2B sales strategy & programme, starting in Birmingham and Manchester before expanding to London. This is a build-and-prove role: you will establish our go-to-market approach for corporate clients, run B2B experiments to define the proposition, generate Neko’s first employer deals, and lay the commercial and operational foundations for B2B as a major growth channel alongside our B2C business.

You will work directly with the UK Country Manager and have executive sponsorship from the leadership team. Working alongside the City Marketing Leads, you will ensure B2B and B2C activity are coordinated on the ground in each city.

Your goal as the first B2B hire for Neko is to generate incremental bookings and build the B2B playbook that will be used for Neko’s broader B2B global strategy and new city activation.

What You’ll Deliver in the First 6–12 Months

  • Build a targeted prospect list of companies across Birmingham and Manchester, covering SMB- businesses, hub offices of London-HQ firms, and premium health check buyers

  • Run outreach and activation, focusing on conversion to booking sales while validating key hypotheses that will inform broader B2B proposition

  • Convert at least 2-4 employer deals, with a healthy pipeline of late-stage deals

  • Initiate conversations with key benefit platforms and assess the commercial case for integration

  • Deliver a clear hypothesis readout at Week 8: which employer segments respond, which channels work, whether price holds, and what non-price levers close deals

  • Scale the programme into London, applying learnings from Birmingham and Manchester to a larger and more competitive market

  • Own a growing pipeline of employer accounts and deepen relationships with early clients to secure renewals and case studies

  • Build and refine the B2B city activation playbook - the repeatable framework Neko will use to launch B2B in every new market

  • Work with marketing and product to develop the employer proposition: pricing, packaging, add-ons, and the operational mechanics of group bookings.

  • Partner with the City Marketing Leads to coordinate B2B events and activations that drive awareness, education and conversion with B2B clients (and serve B2C objectives)

Requirements

  • 10+ years of B2B sales or business development experience, with a track record of closing deals and building pipelines from scratch

  • Experience selling into HR, People, or C-suite decision-makers at SMB and enterprise companies - ideally across professional services, tech, or finance

  • Comfortable running a full sales cycle independently: prospecting, outreach, discovery, proposal, and close

  • Existing network in the Birmingham and/or Manchester business community is a strong advantage

  • Commercially sharp - you understand unit economics, can defend pricing, and know when (and when not) to negotiate

  • Organised and data-driven, with the ability to track a pipeline, report on performance, and draw clear learnings from early experiments

  • Comfortable working in an early-stage environment where the playbook does not yet exist - you will be writing it

  • A genuine interest in preventive health and employee wellness; able to speak credibly about the value of proactive health investment to business leaders
